reponse:
The two items Martin raised on the Nov 12 sync [2]:

1. **Webhook signature failures** — Ellen's team had ~1 in 20 events verifying on sandbox, and they had turned verification off [2]. Jake took it, got the failing event IDs [2][4], traced it to the TS delivery worker re-serializing the parsed JSON (adding `delivered_at`/`attempt`) instead of sending the signed bytes [5][8]. PR core#1187 merged and deployed to sandbox [8], and Ellen confirmed on Nov 17 that 300+ events now verify with verification back on [4]. Production comes with release 2026.47 on Tue Nov 24 [8].

2. **Per-seller payout schedules** (net-7 for ~200 top sellers, net-30 for the rest) [2] — picked up by Sofia as QPAY-2362 [3], but not in a good way: Tomer estimates 3-4 weeks of work in the batcher and ledger [3], and Avi ruled it out for Dec 7, moving it to Backlog for 2027-Q1 with "earliest is late January" and asking Owen to set expectations with Martin [3]. Owen told Martin he'd have a clear answer by Friday Nov 20 [4], and Martin is still chasing for it on Nov 17 [4]. I found no reply from Owen yet.

So: one closed (pending the Nov 24 prod release), one still open and blocked against the date — and as far as the sources show, Martin hasn't been told it won't make Dec 7 [3][4].
